==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Syncfusion&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using Syncfusion.Licensing;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.Syncfusion: the licence has to be registered before anything is rendered, so it
        // happens here rather than in a test.
        // Without a licence every rendered page carries a trial watermark, which then lands in the
        // verified png and makes the snapshot useless.
        SyncfusionLicenseProvider.RegisterLicense(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SyncfusionLicense")!);

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/SyncfusionTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Syncfusion&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.Syncfusion: Verifies pdf, docx, xlsx and pptx documents through Syncfusion File Formats, as text, csv and rendered pages.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Syncfusion
// Note: A licence key is required. The samples read it from the SyncfusionLicense environment
// variable; without one every rendered page is watermarked.
// Note: The package carries an open source maintenance fee and an EULA, so
// PackageRequireLicenseAcceptance is set and the fee applies to every organization using it.
// Note: Each verification writes numbered targets: #00 for the document info and #01 onward for
// the rendered pages or slides.
// Note: PagesToInclude and PdfPngDevice are in the source but not in the readme.
// Note: VerifierSettings.ExcludeTargets("xlsx") applies the binary exclusion to every test instead
// of one.
// Note: Rendered png differs slightly between machines; the plugin's own tests call
// VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng(.7) to tolerate it.
// Note: Sample documents need <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory> in the
// test project.
// Note: PagesToInclude and SkipPdfNormalization are defined by six packages in the VerifyTests
// namespace, so the samples call the static form to avoid CS0121 (plan A6, retired by C4).
public class SyncfusionTests
{
    // A pdf is verified as an info object holding its metadata plus one rendered png per page,
    // so a layout change is visible rather than hidden inside a binary.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task Pdf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf");
    }

    // A workbook is verified as csv and as rendered pages, and the source document is also
    // written back as a deterministic .verified.xlsx.
    // Building that binary is expensive and it is rarely wanted in source control, so
    // ExcludeTargets drops it and skips the work.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task Excel()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.xlsx")
            .ExcludeTargets("xlsx");
    }

    // A Word file is verified twice over: its text, which reads well in a diff, and a png of
    // each page, which catches a layout change the text cannot show.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.docx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.docx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task Word()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.docx")
            .ExcludeTargets("docx");
    }

    // Each slide is rendered to its own numbered png, so a deck's diff names the slide that
    // changed instead of the whole file.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pptx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pptx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task PowerPoint()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pptx")
            .ExcludeTargets("pptx");
    }

    // Rendering every page of a long document is slow and commits a lot of binary. This keeps
    // the first page only; a full document binary target is unaffected.
    // The static form is used because six packages define PagesToInclude as an extension method
    // in the VerifyTests namespace, so the instance call is ambiguous once two are referenced.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task FirstPageOnly()
    {
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        VerifySyncfusionSettings.PagesToInclude(settings, 1);

        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf", settings);
    }

    // Deflate compresses differently per runtime, so the bytes of a binary target differ across
    // target frameworks even though the xml inside is identical. A snapshot per runtime avoids it.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense
    // environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, and a SyncfusionLicense environment variable.")]
    public async Task UniqueForRuntime()
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead("sample.xlsx");

        await Verify(stream, "xlsx")
            .UniqueForRuntime();
    }
}


==== packages

Verify.XunitV3

==== interactions

Warning licence-required: Syncfusion needs A Syncfusion licence: Syncfusion File Formats is commercial. The key is read from an environment variable so it never lands in source control.
